title: Hausdorff measure of an n-disc in an n-dimensional subspace: Hⁿ(P ∩ B̄_s(0)) = sⁿω_n (parent Step 1)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let P ⊆ ℝ^N be a linear subspace with dim P = n, and let s > 0. Then Hⁿ(P ∩ B̄_s(0)) = sⁿ·ω_n in [0, ∞]. Here Hⁿ = μHE[n], B̄_s(0) is the closed ball of ℝ^N, and ω_n := Lⁿ(B_1(0)) is the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of ℝⁿ (ω₀ = 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ P = n → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → μHE[n] ((P : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 s) = ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n) * volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)
